rsm:PollutantRelease.rsm:RemarkText:
Following an investigation, the higher than normal levels of HF and SOX have been attributed to issues around the scrubber media, insofar as the level indicator not registering when the scrubber media required refilling. The PRTR return was therefore based on higher than normal readings obtained during annual extractive testing, which have been extrapolate to give an annual figure based on annual production rates.
Ibstock have conducted a full review of the scrubber system and performed maintenance on it so that the issue is resolved, together with introducing enhanced procedures for checking scrubber media levels.
Ibstock have recently had the kiln emissions retested by an independent test agency and are awaiting results of those tests. With the work carried out on the scrubber they expect the levels to be within the requirements of the permit and therefore the reduced levels will be reflected in the next PRTR return.

rsm:PollutantRelease.rsm:RemarkText: Our abatement plant suffered some mechanical failures over the course of last year. This meant that significantly more CO was released than normal for a short part of the year- high enough to significantly increase the average emissions from the abatement plant. This was repaired, and has been running as expected since then. We are planning to replace the abatement plant with a newer model within the next two years.

Our tests include measurements taken from the 'calender pit' near one of our machines. Due to a number of leaks being repaired in recent years the water in this pit has largely dried up and a very small amount remains. When Northumbria water came to carry out testing they noted that in order to collect a sample from this area they had to scrape the sample container on the bottom, which would lead to the sample measurement reading high levels of contamination.
